lines.speaker: Ben as Quill Emberwick
lines.text: Quill tucks Mara's journal under his arm: You three check the wreck. I'm heading back up to the lighthouse to study these pages alone.

lines.speaker: DM
lines.text: Quill, are you ready to head back to the lighthouse alone to study the journal? Let us know.
Quill Emberwick arrives at Brinewatch Lighthouse.
The scene cuts to Brienne Saltblade, Sister Morra Tideward, Pip at Brinewatch Harbor Docks.
